fieldData.meta-description: Build a customer feedback survey that sorts comments by theme, saves each answer with its customer and routes complaints to an owner.
fieldData.awb---key-feature-1-content:
Find out why subscribers cancel

Once Stripe reports a canceled subscription, the subscriber gets a three-question email: the main reason, what would bring them back and anything else. Each answer is saved with the plan and months subscribed. Over 30 days, 112 of 160 canceling subscribers answered, and price led with 41.
fieldData.awb---integration-feature-2:
A text after every repair visit

Two hours after the technician closes the job, the customer gets a text through Twilio. It asks for a star rating, whether the tech arrived in the booked window and what went wrong, if anything. A rating of 2 or lower becomes a callback task for the dispatcher, with the job number and the comment.
